name: intervals-mcp-with-stryd
description: An Intervals.icu MCP server built for Stryd runners — power-based running analysis (a dual PMC with RSS and LBSS), designed so the LLM never does the math.

athlete_id.title: Intervals.icu Athlete ID
athlete_id.description: Your athlete ID (starts with "i", e.g. i12345678), from the Intervals.icu URL or Settings. You may also use "0" for the API key owner.

api_key.title: Intervals.icu API Key
api_key.description: API key from Intervals.icu → Settings → Developer. Stored in your OS keychain. Grants full account access — see Security & privacy: https://github.com/methylone/Intervals-MCP-Server-with-STRYD/blob/main/SECURITY.md

timezone.title: Athlete Timezone (IANA)
timezone.description: IANA timezone name, e.g. Asia/Tokyo or UTC. Affects "today" and Mon–Sun week boundaries.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Withhold the four calendar-writing tools (no writes to your Intervals.icu account). See https://github.com/methylone/Intervals-MCP-Server-with-STRYD/blob/main/SECURITY.md

cache_enabled.title: Enable stream cache
cache_enabled.description: Cache activity streams on disk for faster re-analysis. See https://github.com/methylone/Intervals-MCP-Server-with-STRYD/blob/main/SECURITY.md

lbss_field.title: LBSS custom-field code
lbss_field.description: Intervals.icu custom-field code the LBSS PMC is built on (CamelCase, no underscore). Default StrydLBSSv2 (Stryd-faithful recalibration). If your account only has the community StrydLBSSmod field, build StrydLBSSv2 from the field recipes or set this to StrydLBSSmod. Recipes: https://github.com/methylone/Intervals-MCP-Server-with-STRYD/wiki/LLM-Agent-Recipes

ilr_field.title: ILR custom-field code
ilr_field.description: Intervals.icu custom-field code for Impact Loading Rate (CamelCase, no underscore). Default StrydILR.

ecc_field.title: Eccentric LBSS custom-field code
ecc_field.description: Intervals.icu custom-field code for eccentric LBSS (CamelCase, no underscore), reported when a tool is called with include_ecc=true. Default EccLBSS; leave blank to disable include_ecc.

extra_stream_fields.title: Extra custom stream codes
extra_stream_fields.description: Comma-separated Intervals.icu custom stream codes to surface as per-split averages in get_activity_streams_summary (extras / extras_run). Each code must be mapped in Intervals.icu Settings → Developer → Custom Streams before use. Recommended: StrydLSS,StrydTemp,StrydHumidity (requires the Wiki stream setup). Leave blank to disable.

tools.name: get_activities
tools.description: Fetch a list of Intervals.icu activities for a date range.

tools.name: get_activity_detail
tools.description: Fetch complete data for a single Intervals.icu activity, including power/HR zone distributions (icu_zone_times, icu_hr_zone_times), Stryd metrics (the configured LBSS/ILR custom fields), decoupling, and all other fields.

tools.name: get_activity_streams_summary
tools.description: Fetch activity stream data, clean/split/aggregate, and return a summary with splits, cardiac decoupling, and efficiency metrics.

tools.name: search_similar_activities
tools.description: Search past activities within a date range using optional filters (type, name keyword, distance, duration, temperature).

tools.name: get_wellness
tools.description: Fetch daily wellness data for a date range from Intervals.icu.

tools.name: get_athlete_summary
tools.description: Fetch an aggregated athlete summary for a date range from Intervals.icu.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Fetch calendar events (planned workouts, races, notes) from Intervals.icu for a date range.

tools.name: create_events
tools.description: Create one or more calendar events (planned workouts, races, notes) on Intervals.icu.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Update an existing calendar event on Intervals.icu.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event from Intervals.icu.

tools.name: delete_events
tools.description: Delete multiple calendar events from Intervals.icu in one call.

tools.name: get_hrv_trends
tools.description: Calculate rolling HRV statistics (mean, SD, coefficient of variation) for recovery trend analysis.

tools.name: list_gear
tools.description: Fetch all gear (shoes/bikes) for the athlete from Intervals.icu as a raw passthrough, including retired gear and odometer (distance/time) fields.

tools.name: assign_gear
tools.description: Assign a gear item (shoe) to one or more activities on Intervals.icu. Writes to the account (withheld in READ_ONLY); skips activities already on the target gear.

tools.name: create_gear
tools.description: Create a new gear item (shoe/bike) on Intervals.icu. Writes to the account (withheld in READ_ONLY); returns the created gear whose id is usable with assign_gear.

tools.name: retire_gear
tools.description: Retire a gear item (shoe) on Intervals.icu so it stops appearing as a default assignment. Writes to the account (withheld in READ_ONLY); un-retire is out of scope.

tools.name: clear_cache
tools.description: Clear the on-disk stream cache (all cached activities, or a single one).

tools.name: set_cache_enabled
tools.description: Turn the on-disk stream cache on or off at runtime, or query its current state.

tools.name: get_current_pmc
tools.description: Get today's Performance Management Chart (PMC) values.

tools.name: get_weekly_summary
tools.description: Get a weekly training summary for a given week (Mon–Sun).

tools.name: get_phase_summary
tools.description: Get a training phase summary with per-week breakdown and ramp rate analysis.

tools.name: estimate_critical_impact
tools.description: Reverse-estimate Stryd Critical Impact (CI) for LBSS calibration from Intervals streams (watts/ILR/altitude/distance) and Critical Power, with no Stryd API.

tools.name: update_lbss_ci_table
tools.description: Update the per-shoe Critical Impact (CI) table in the LBSS custom-field scripts (LBSS + Ecc fields together). Writes to the account (withheld in READ_ONLY); dry-run by default, rewrites only the managed CI_TABLE sentinel line.
